_meta.description: Avios is one currency shared by several programs. Moving Avios between them ("Combine Avios") lets a balance in one program book awards priced in another. Use this to route Livelo/Esfera/Amex NL points along the cheapest path into Iberia, and to book BA/Qatar/Aer Lingus-priced awards with Iberia Avios.
_meta.confidence_levels: VERIFIED = primary source + 1 secondary; LIKELY = single primary or multiple secondaries agree; UNVERIFIED = single secondary.

iberia.name: Iberia Club
iberia.note: Not on Seats.aero. Off-peak pricing on Iberia metal (e.g. MAD-FOR) is usually the cheapest Avios use.

british_airways.name: British Airways Club
british_airways.note: Hub for Combine Avios. Transfers from Qatar and Finnair go through BA.

qatar.name: Qatar Airways Privilege Club
qatar.note: On Seats.aero, so Qatar results are a stand-in for Avios availability on oneworld partners (Iberia, BA, LATAM is NOT oneworld).

finnair.name: Finnair Plus
finnair.note: Fixed partner chart. LATAM Brazil domestic flights cost 6,000 Avios one way in economy (see finnair_latam_chart), often far below LATAM Pass dynamic prices. LATAM awards are booked by Finnair Plus chat or phone, not online.

combine_rules.rule: Account must be held at least 30 days before moving Avios out (introduced 2026).
Iberia account must have had Avios credited at least once (be active) before receiving/sending.
Name on both accounts must match. Moves are done from the BA 'Combine Avios' tool or the Qatar 'Manage your Avios' page.
Qatar person-to-person transfers: up to 250,000 Avios/year in blocks of 1,000, posted within 72 hours.

cheapest_paths_into_iberia.beats: Amex NL MR -> Iberia direct (3:2 = 1.5 MR per Avios)

iberia_family_account.requirement: No address or relationship requirement. 12-month commitment reported.

finnair_latam_chart._note: Finnair Plus fixed chart for flights operated by LATAM. Avios per person, one way, taxes and fees paid in cash on top. Checked on finnair.com on 2026-11-25.

latam_brazil.route: Brazil to Central and North America

rules.rule: Price is per person. One way or round trip. Only flights operated by LATAM, and no mixing two partner airlines on one award.
Connections must be the first possible flight and no stopovers are allowed. Whether a connecting domestic itinerary (e.g. GRU-BSB-FOR) still prices as one 6,000 award is not stated.
Mixed cabins price at the highest cabin. Ticketed within one day of the reservation. Change and cancellation fees apply. No waitlist.
LATAM awards cannot be searched or booked on finnair.com. Book through Finnair Plus chat (English) or phone.
Since about November 2026 the chat agent only checks partner availability if the account already holds enough Avios for the award.
LATAM business saver space visible in Iberia Club and BA was not offered to Finnair Plus in a July 2026 test. Treat business as unlikely.
LATAM award space is shared across partners, so find the flight first in Iberia Club or BA search, then ask Finnair to book it.
No child discount is published. Infant under 2 pricing on LATAM through Finnair is not published.

cheapest_paths_into_finnair.path: Amex NL MR -> BA (5:4) -> Finnair combine
